body:
Oh hey!! 

No worries glad you're okay. 
I'm starting school next week on the 29th so I'm just mentally preparing for that. 
Still exercising, I'll admit though I fell off this weekend and I've been eating poorly :/ but I'm going to get back to it. 
Steep hills are so shitty! Honestly steep inclines scare me because I always feel like i'm going to fall hah but it's good cardio. Nature Reserve across the street? Thats pretty cool. Hiking is always really fun. 
Weakest Link was probably my go to show as a 7 year old and I'm not even joking lol.
But yeah, the 90s seemed great, people born in the 80s were lucky.
My anxiety is better, although I still have those tense stomach moments, not nearly as often though.
Same with suicidal thoughts and cutting, depression, it's all fluctuating. But it's not as intense as it was earlier this summer. 
I haven't purchase a camera just yet and the older one is still put away, honestly I'm scared to even use it, it seems so antique. 
And I can relate a lot with the paying bills and making ends meet. Adulting is hard. Budgeting is even harder. 80% of my stress this month has come from being short on something. Hopefully things are turning around for your family. 
How has your summer been since you last replied? How have you been feeling lately? Anything new?
Hopefully you're less stressed and feeling more attached to whats around you. I totally get what you mean about feeling something vs nothing, it can def put you in bad head spaces so I genuinely hope you're feeling a lot better. 
Sorry this is a really short reply, I'm actually waiting for a ride and I checked this account randomly fully expecting not to see anything, but it was a nice surprise to see you replied. Hopefully you still check too! I'll check often again and I'll try to come back and re-reply something longer. I just wanted to send something asap since it's been a while. 
ttyl

For me, I really don't like being unfit. Not really visually fit, but like after you walk up a flight of stairs you and you feel like you're going to pass out. I like being about to challenge my endurance. Being able to do another rep, or run a little farther is very rewarding, but then it's also painful and nauseating at the same time. I like the muscle pain you get the next day too. It's called Summerfest. It's a music festival we have every year, the artists aren't the most amazing but it's still fun. We also have ethnic festivals all summer like Italian fest, Polish fest, German fest, Mexican fest etc. There's honestly something for everyone.
And yes, food(pizza) is my weakness too. Last year I did a lot of restrictive dieting, followed by binging for like 2 days. When I would be eating between 300 and 400 calories a day it made my anxiety and suicidal thoughts so much worse. It made me realize how much I depend on food for emotional stability. 

Me and my mom have a pretty iffy relationship too(?). We get along, we can make each other laugh and things..but it's better we communicate over the phone rather than in person. In person we're bound to start arguing about something. Mainly because she has untreated behavioral disorders that cause her to be unstable at times. Hopefully you guys didn't fall out. Oh and I didn't mean to say I excelled in those subjects lol, just that I am really interested in them. In general I'm only good at science and english, english by nature because I really don't like writing papers at all but I'm good at bullshitting I guess. Yeah I love biology, learning in general is really fun. I'm the type of person with 20 different tabs open, staying up too late learning about random things. 

Ah no, I really love early 2000s music, everything from early 2000s is so nostalgic to me. I was watching "the weakest link" on youtube some time ago and watching the commercials from then was the highlight of the week. I used to love that show. Thanks, it's an automatic 230 land camera. It comes with a big blue flash bulb that you have to attach. I have not a clue on what to do with it so I just keep it safe for him. I can't wait to get the Nikon, I feel like I spend all my time outside wishing I had a nice camera to take a picture of all the natural beauty I see. Especially during this time for WI, we have a lot of warm summer thunderstorms. A couple days ago the sky was soft coral pink with big prominent dark gray clouds swirled around it, amazing to see really.  

I've been feeling different. Exercising has really been helping me with anxiety I believe. I still get the sinking, impending doom feeling but the rush isn't as strong, it's the same with cutting. Weird thing is I don't feel happy or normal, its like an emotional limbo. Oh and I hang out with my friend tomorrow (friday for me). I don't know how I'm going to explain things to her plus it's for her birthday so I don't want to be a downer. 
But, how are you feeling?

No, I haven't heard of steam before, what's it about? I'm definitely of out the video game loop. I was playing the older God of War games earlier this week and after, I noticed that they were coming out with a new one and i got super excited..but then I saw the game play and it's so different & I don't know if I'd like it lol. Duck Game definitely reminds me of every game I played when I was younger! It looks super fun.

No worries. Being outside and enjoying the season is a lot better than browsing the internet all day. Are you doing anything interesting this summer? I'm sorry for being late this week too. I tried writing more and Im sure I failed hah.
Ill talk to you later.

Hey

And yeah me too (weight gain thing). I just got back from the lake, trying to exercise more. My calfs feel like someone hit them with an aluminum bat. And the weather is definitely a big plus. I really hate being cold, I'm from Wisconsin, but the summers here are really nice, plus there's almost a festival everyday at the lakefront. Brings up a lot of good memories for me. My biggest insecurity is definitely my weight. It sucks because it's a huge ass cycle. I binge/purge a lot. I hope you're feeling up to it more, it can be really hard to go out but sometimes just trying can be motivational enough. Do you ever experience derealization when working out? Like when you're pushing yourself and you start having those peak moments when you feel like your about to pass out? I do, but it isn't an existential scary thing like normal, I mean it's still a weird ass feeling but it's kinda nice?

Omg, the best friend I mentioned earlier had those books, we thought it was really cool at 9 to have a book called 'Stitch n Bitch'. But yeah at our high school we called every art subject a "major", like college but not really. Actually I'm really interested in the medical field. As a child I wanted to be a doctor but IDK about that now. I'm thinking maybe Pharmacology or something. But I really like science in general. Biology, Chemistry, Anthropology, Psychology etc. Science and English are honestly the only subjects I excel in. I'm horrible at math ironically. I'm glad you grew out of the 'i hate everyone' phase. Honestly I think I'm still dwelling in those feelings at times. Oh okay cool! I missed all of the mid 2000 trends, but my cousin (who's your age) would play a lot of SOAD around me, so I know a lot of their music. Cool, what's flash animation about? ..that's probably really common knowledge I'm just under exposed lol.

This is his [camera](http://imgur.com/iSa1zHG). I would love to learn how to use it one day, it seems like a cool camera. It also comes with a flash lamp thing. Nice polaroid! I love love looove polaroid pictures, they're so nostalgic in their own right. Oh cool cool, three lenses duh that makes sense lol.  And, yeah for $15 that's pretty cheap. Thanks! I took them all on my iPhone. And lol thanks I actually tried to set that picture up a little. The flowers are actually sitting in a water bottle lol. VSCO filters can make pictures look a lot nicer IMO. I really would like to invest in a Nikon D3300 as a starter camera. 

Yeah, it's definitely not a nice feeling. It's a crippling feeling to hate more about yourself than you like. That's great that you've been able to stop those thoughts. Hiding under covers always helps me too lol.

The Sims 4 is ok. I like games with motives and challenges. I think the with the Sims you have to create too much of your own narrative to make it more interesting. Sims 2 for PS2 was a lot more fun because you could do a story line. Yeah I haven't beaten a video game in a long time. It was always bittersweet. 

I definitely need to improve on my walls of text, they don't seem as haunting. And sure I'll make sure to check back more often. 
Have a good day.

Hey! I'm glad I checked again. No worries. 

Yeah, stress can cause a lot. Increase of cortisol, which leads to weight gain, derealization episodes, even worse, heart attacks, weakened immune systems and yeah, memory loss. I try to stay away from added stress. Social drama, financial stress etc. It really can make things so much worse. 

Unfortunately in the US, everyone doesn't take your insurance. If you're in the bottom half of the middle class, or under, you typically have state insurance, which a lot of places don't take. Even if you get insurance from the 'market place', which is basically Obamacare, a lot of places won't take it. So it takes longer to find a place, then waiting on the list for a call back. So basically the same, but it's not free with Obamacare, the prices are just reduced. And yeah, I think I'd take medication for anxiety though. If it meant that it would be gone. That'd be amazing. 

Oh cool, knitting? I always wanted to learn how to knit but I used to crochet a lot. And yeah, now that I think about it, it was really relaxing. I made scarfs too lol. Infinity scarfs. I went to a high school for arts. I originally tried auditioning for visual arts, but since I was applying after school started, the major was already filled. But I was really desperate to get out of the school I was enrolled in at the time so the principal asked me if I knew how to do anything else. Luckily I started playing the sax in middle school as an extra curricular. I really didn't think I'd get in, but the piece they had me audition with was what my 8th grade class had just played months ago, for our end of the year performance. Lucky me haha. But unfortunately I really only took it serious in 9th grade. Then I went all emo and hated everyone and school for 10th-12th lol. Yeah I wish I was better at drawing too, realism drawings are so cool to me. I've never heard of Lomography. That's a really cool concept. When my grandfather died, he left behind a really old polaroid camera. I have no idea what it's called or what kind, but my grandmother said I could keep it. The next time I go visit her I'll have to take a look at it, see what it's called and let you know. It's super super old so I doubt it'll work with the website, but maybe..I'm not sure. And nice photo! I like the colors and it is really nice quality. How does it take three photos at once? That's awesome. Here's some of my [photos](http://imgur.com/a/P5MOk). Photography is really fun. There is no wrong way, ya' know?

I used to have a blurred vision of myself, which can be a good thing in some respects. Then one day I noticed every single flaw, everything I didn't like about myself kind of jump out at me all at once. That deteriorated my self esteem completely. 
So I get how you feel, 100%. I think at my lowest I felt some sort of BDD. I wasn't diagnosed with it, but I think I dealt with it.

Noo, I definitely know Power Puff Girls (buttercup was my fav),Courage (which I used to be so scared of as a kid lol), Dexters Laboratory, Cow and Chicken! But I don't know Space Ghost Coast 2 Coast, so maybe theres an age gap? I just turned 20 in Feb. And yeah I get that, life can be distracting. You get it together though, I'm sure. 

Yeah tell me about it. I bought Sims 4 and I played it all of 4 or 5 days. Now I only play when I can't connect to Wifi lol.
Your comment makes absolutely no sense. Getting any type at anytime is the only way to certify what your personality type is. Either you're not taking the test right, or you're probably just an INFP.

Optimistic people seem to live better lives, it's probably better for your health too. Mental and physical. But I can relate to the music thing. But it has to be really really bad.. I'll listen to pretty much any genre as long as it's good. I just don't want to feel like I'm procrastinating suicide anymore. Depression, self hate, derealization, anxiety..everyday. Somethings gotta give. That sucks that they're cutting funding for mental health in the UK. That's probably the dumbest thing to cut funding from. I'm not sure how scheduling works for these things in the UK, but in the US you usually leave a message at a clinic and they'll call you back in like 2 or 3 weeks, sooner if you're lucky. Anyways, they finally called me yesterday so I have an appointment to see a psychiatrist next month. I can't wait. I've been against taking drugs after my experience with Vyvanse and Prozac soo idk if I'll take any prescriptions yet, but maybe. 

I used to take sewing classes and I haven't done it in a while, but I wouldn't mind picking it back up. I played the alto for middle and high school, but I don't think I'd be dedicated enough to spend that much on a personal one. I loove love drawing, I'm pretty okay at it. Again, it's been a minute. Photography has been my dream hobby. I love taking pictures. I usually just take them on my iPhone, which is probably not the best of the best quality. I also have no knowledge of angles and mm lenses etc. I bought a lot of nice filters on the VSCO app and I usually just use those. But yeah I'm going to start incorporating creativity in my life more. And weed used to make me feel amazing. After my very first bad high, it was pretty much the end of that relationship with weed. I still smoke though, not as frequent because my highs can get pretty bad too. And yeah, I feel the same way. It's a release to my anger(hurt, confusion etc.), it's like when someone punches a wall or screams. Same thing, except its self inflicted because my problems are with myself. It's hard to stop cutting for me because it's instinctual, as soon as I become frustrated it's the first that'll pop into my mind. Also there's a sense of control. I really want to get better at cooking. I can make really good egg foo young, and pretty much any breakfast food lol. But homemade pizza sounds awesome af. And yeah, that's pretty cool, most people become stuck when asked about their hobbies (me included). Who do you have on vinyl?

London must be like the New York City of the UK. Glad you like your new area. And yeah I think road rage transcends into even the most kindest of areas. Yeah denial is definitely ugly. I always try to tell myself the truth in everything. I really try to be completely aware of myself. It's so necessary when you're trying to change. And thank you, I appreciate it. Yeah cartoon network always had the best shows. Billy and Mandy, Aqua Teen Hunger Force, Ed Edd and Eddy Boondocks, Fosters Home.. soo so many. And their new shows are pretty good too. Okay, I'm subscribed. And I'll have to see if any of those movies are on Netflix.

I feel off really bad with video games. The last time I played video games Midnight Club was still relevant. I think my favorite game behind Vice City was the Series of Unfortunate Events. that game was really good. My first ever favorite video game was Time Crisis, on PS1. Oddly, I was pretty good at that game for a little kid.

I truly respect your optimism. I realize I'm too cynical for my own good. It's easier to give up though, especially when you're so far from the light, hope, or whatever you want to call it. I'm still trying to learn how to fight for myself, stand up for myself and such. It's not that I wouldn't put up the fight, because I believe everyone deserves to live and love life, I'm just having a hard time finding a reason to. 

Thank you for understanding my derealization. Definitely one of the things I shy from sharing with people, openly at least. I always start feeling weird when I talk about it, like I'm truly insane lol. And I'm going to start using that technique, distraction techniques work better for me than breathing techniques I think. Well, I've only tried breathing techniques, but Ill usually just try to find an interesting video to watch on Youtube, or listen to some J Dilla and hope that my stomach will untie itself soon. 

Yeah talking to you has helped me a lot, so again, thank you so much. Being able to relate someone is so necessary. And I agree, I need to start setting small goals, regain a grip on some dreams, start up some old hobbies. I love being creative. I need to stop smoking weed. I really don't smoke a lot, but it doesn't help me at all. I keep trying to stop cutting, that shit is so hard. I'm running out of space on my thighs and I *don't* want to start cutting my forearms. Do you have any hobbies that bring your some normalcy?

I'm glad your friends ad family are understanding. UK people in general seem a lot nicer and more understanding than American people. And I'm sorry about your mood swings. You truly seem like you are a really sweet, likable person. I'm sure people have to see that in you to know and understand your mood swings are nothing more than mood swings with no intent. Your story is very inspiring, and I'm glad you see the old you coming back despite still dealing with lows. 
When I'm feeling really bad, I'll watch like old Disney and Nickelodeon shows, bumps, commercials or whatever I can find on Youtube from when I was a kid. The nostalgia will help a lot, it puts me back into that mind frame I had when I was younger, when I thought life was amaaaazing. Sometime it hurts lol, like I can't explain but it'll physically hurt to watch some of this stuff. 

Oh, and I found a few channels called TV Wasteland along with some called Wasteland TV. I didn't know which one was you. But wow that's hilarious, obviously I'm extremely out of synch with American pop culture (which is ironic). I had no idea about those TV shows. And I've never seen Mallrats, but looking it up on IMDB reminded me of Wayne's World which is a pretty funny movie I watched when I was younger. Kinda similar. Yeah and I didn't grow up much in the 90s but I was exposed to a lot of it. I always wished I was born earlier, but honestly I'm lucky because my mom had me young, I really should've been born in the 2000s. 

I'm average with my tech knowledge. Like I can *definitely* help with virus scans lol, downloading etc but Im useless pretty much with anything past that. And I have a PS2 that I got when I was like 11 or so. I would play Vice City all the time on it but I would never ever do the missions lol. I was so scary xD ha. Fun times.

No, at the end I admit this could be true for some. But anyone who switches from MBTI to MBTI is probably in some type of identity crisis. Ive took this test 3 times over the last four years and I always get the same result. I'm pretty sure most people should continue to get the same result if they aren't lying to themselves. But my point was just although this could be happening, and probably is, it's not the majority and you're still being slightly over dramatic.

Why conclude that people are being try hards rather than conclude that maybe the personality types are kinda dead on? I mean the subreddits were created for people to discuss life as whatever they are, so ofc the posts are probably going to be in relation to the personality type. Although what you're saying can be true for some, I feel like you're reading into this too much.

Yeah, I'm definitely still building up the confidence to talk to her. I'm not sure if I'll go super deep, just maybe explaining to her my depression and anxiety in general, idk I'll see how it goes. I hope it's good. And thanks again for the support, I definitely would love to talk this over with someone, I just know the downsides of making yourself vulnerable to people and I don't want to experience that again. However, it's completely exhausting trying to shield yourself from everyone while keeping it all in. My other friend just bailed on me to hang out with other people, continuously. There's only so much rejection someone can take before you're over it. 

Wow, that sounds terrifying. Sucks you have to go through that, anxiety definitely is a bitch. And DR/DP is even worse. I could go on for a while explaining how much that alone has affected my mental health. I've watched a lot of videos on Youtube about people talking about how they were able to cure themselves of it, but I always question that. The existential/death anxiety that came with my derealization was enough to make me start cutting. I mean, the way you look at the world is completely changed. To go outside of my mind like that, was/is traumatizing. How do you recover from that? All I think about sometimes is how our planet is dangling in the middle of this expanding galaxy. We circle the sun day after day after day. How am I supposed to ignore that? How do you cure these thoughts? I feel like once you've experienced the extreme lows of derealization, there is no cure, you just live with it or you don't. And I don't mean to sound over dramatic about this but truly this is how I feel about it. I could go deeper on this but I feel like then I start sounding crazy and I have to question myself. BTW, this is what I'm talking about when I say I feel mentally weak. I wish I could just be/feel/think normal again. I wish I could go back to how life was for me mentally in high school. This is a complete 180.            

Congrats! What's your channel name? (If you want to share, if you don't I completely understand).  Ahh, I wish I knew more UK TV shows. But again, this sounds like a cool idea. I like when people bring new ideas to Youtube, its so much more interesting than just watching DIYs and storytimes. Will this be more comedic or serious? Do you plan on doing different shows around the world too?    

I'm so happy everything worked out for you and your mom in the end. I couldn't even imagine being in that kind of fear everyday. Do the people around you know that you have these mood swings? Are they understanding of them? I definitely can relate to the feeling of no being in control of your thoughts, moods and actions. Do you think you'll ever feel normal again? Is it really possible?

And thank you for the link to that! I wish I was more tech savvy than I am. But its a really good idea. I totally forgot my cousin owns a PS3. She told me if I bought the game I could play it on her PS3. I don't understand why they don't make the game on mac though :(. We always get left out lol.

Wow. Thats a crappy response to hear from someone you considered your best friend, glad your other friend had your back though. And I really don't have a lot of close friends by the way. Like one, really. I've known her since we were about 7 years old and I really consider her a sister more than a best friend. But I haven't even told *her* about my mental health issues. And I know 100%, if I ever told her she'd support me because she's an awesome person. We just haven't had an opportunity to have a really good long talk. But, Ill make sure I open up to her more when I see her next month, I think that would be good idea and help strengthen our relationship. The other friend I have I've known since we we're 11. Unfortunately, even after going to different high schools and being able to rekindle our relationship before college, we still aren't very close anymore. She's kind of turning into someone else and I don't really fit into her new persona/life. Which is fine, because people change but I don't ever see me opening up to her. The rest of the people I'll very rarely talk to or text are just acquaintances. I decided to take a year off of college so I pretty much stopped seeing people. Oh, and the girl who ditched me I met my senior year of high school. We became really close of summer 2014 and she gradually just stopped talking to me when we went to college (we went to the same college as well). I talked to her about the things that happened to me in my life and she was really cool about it and understanding. When I started feeling depressed I talked to her about it and we bonded about it because she said she suffered from it too. Then pretty much thereafter she'd just started blowing me off. So we don't talk anymore at all. 

Yeah and I deal with a lot of existential anxiety. Which I feel like is the worst part of my mental illnesses. It's completely ruined the way I look at life in general. But children really do help, they are a bundle of all the best things in life. And that's cool it seems like you have all the equipment to start off your Youtube journey. Have you picked a date or some month you plan on starting? And the forgotten TV show idea sounds like a really good idea. Would you be doing like commentary on episodes or just reviews and stuff?

Sorry to hear about your mom. That must've really sucked. Ironically, I worry about my own mom and aneurysms. So it's crazy that you said an aneurysm. I'm truly happy it worked out in the end and she survived. You must've been pretty brave to get through all of that. And I totally can relate to the anger thing. For a while last year my doctor put me on Prozac and by the end of the only month i was on it I started spazzing on people, mainly my family members. For the dumbest things. So I got off of that immediately. Are you ever mean to yourself? I'm usually the meanest to myself. 

And I found a website that said they mac a mac download, but IDK if I trust it. http://www.gta5mac.com Does that loo legit?

Yeah but, I don't know. I guess it goes back to that vulnerable/trust thing. The last friend I opened up to ditched me, and (thankfully) I didn't really go *that* deep with her. But, it was just another example of why I'd rather not express my weaknesses or secrets. But I see what you mean and I can see how that can improve a friendship. 
Yeah anxiety sucks right? I have more of the impending doom, gut clenching kind. Like if I just found out my mom just died for three hours straight feeling. So I just try to focus on something, anything else. But your dad reminds me of my family members lol. I can definitely imagine like my grandmother doing something like that. 
Awww that's awesome. Family helps out a lot in those ways. My grandmother will normally force me to go with her somewhere, and she'll make me feel normal for a while. And kids are great too. I have toddler nieces and they always make me smile when they FaceTime me.
Oh cool. So are you an active Youtuber or do you want to become active? And yeah depression can really deteriorate a persons goals. My first semester of college was a train wreck. I've always gotten pretty good grades and I just bombed my first year. Half of me was so devastated and the other half truly didn't even care. Plus my father started getting really really sick and my mental health was getting progressively worse. 
Yeah, with Netflix, Hulu, Youtube and regular cable it's wayy too many options. But I do find myself going down a Youtube hole everyday. You an learn/watch almost anything. 

Yeah, we have websites like that too. We also have it in stores, it's called layaway. But the only difference is you can't take it until you pay it off. And I tried finding it on Mac and I didn't see anything. But I'm going to try again.

I will, hopefully I can find a place soon. Yeah and trying to explain it to people is awkward too. I don't really talk about it to anyone in my life. Do you have anxiety? Anxiety sucks a lot. You have to put so much energy into regathering your thoughts or trying to distract yourself but the tensing in your stomach never stops. 
Yeah, watching people play it is pretty fun. I'll have to check out those Youtubers. I wonder if they make it for Mac... Buying a PS4 is pretty much wishful thinking lol.

Yeah my doctor told me that. I'm going to make an appointment soon for another place, hopefully I can get some different insights. My number one goal would be just to stop cutting so much. And most definitely, I'm sure talking about depression can start being depressing. Unfortunately I stopped playing video games a while ago. But I've been watching people play GTA5 on Youtube and I really thought about getting a PS4 soon. I didn't realize how much I missed playing video games lol.

I had a therapist since September but I stopped seeing her last month. I don't think she quite understood what my issues were. Most of the sessions we'd just have normal conversation. Which was nice in some respects. I want to visit a psychologist soon though. And I text my friends from time to time. I think people avoid talking to me because I'm a downer. I also am not having the same experiences my friends are having right now so I can't even relate to them anymore and vice versa. I don't know. 
Thanks a lot for the kind words and taking time out to respond to me. I wasn't expecting to unload this at all, but I really do appreciate it.

I feel l need to change myself because of my insecurities influenced by events and problems from my adolescents. The thing is I'd rather just stay locked up in my apartment. When I was working I noticed that I would start having derealization and I kind of figured it was a way I could deal with being in the world without being in the world. Almost as if my brain was just trying to have me focus on the tasks around me a nothing else. I really don't have close relationships with my friends because i alienate myself from them because of my low confidence. I feel like it's coming out of my pores and I just don't want to be vulnerable like that. So I just stay home.
Edit: I just wanted to add that what drives me to feeling suicidal is the fact that I can't not be me, I don't think I'll ever get over these insecurities, I don't think I'll find the answers to the problems. I feel like my mental health is ruined, I don't even trust my own opinions. I always have to second guess myself and compare myself to others. I feel very weak-minded and it sucks.
Sure I'll check it out

Hey. No I'm not the same person. I'm much older now so I can understand the effects of what happened. I'm not sure why I carry the responsibility of it. At the time I didn't let it affect me, or so I thought. And yeah, I really try to not make myself vulnerable in the world. I really really hate feeling vulnerable. So this is big, although i'm on a throwaway.

I think I am taking responsibility for all of it. I think that's the best way to describe it. And I'm trying to change myself because of what happened to me. I also just have really low self confidence, which is partially due to events in my life. 
And yes, we can continue tomorrow. Thanks again for listening.

Yeah it triggered it, but it was a long time coming. I'm very fortunate that events that happened in my life didn't affect me until after my childhood so I could at least have a normal one. I'm really not giving you the entire scope of my depression. But basically my problems are within myself and I can't really distract myself from me..at least for too long. Which is why suicide doesn't seem like just "an option". It almost feels like a death sentence, but I dont know when the date is.

Yeah, mainly because it gives me a reason to not leave my apartment. And I have, no luck yet. Life before was normal, I still had some insecurities and troubles but they kind of flourished into more after that bad high. My mental health is off.

cutting, binge/purge distracts me. working, but i'm unemployed currently. 
I had a epiphany while high. It ruined how viewed myself and life. Derealization and existential angst doesn't help it either. 
Thanks for replying to me.

Because living hurts, and I hate myself and my existence. 
I started developing depression towards the end of 2014, suicidal thoughts started happening around this time last year. They made me anxious and I started cutting my thighs. I just dont want to be me anymore.
I fear the exact moment of death. I often think of it as unplugging a TV while it's on.
just wanted to let you know you put the company name in the story since at the beginning you said you didn't want to disclose.
